posts.text: India hosted the Quad Foreign Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi on May 26. EAM @DrSJaishankar welcomed counterparts from Australia, Japan and the US for discussions on a Free and Open Indo-Pacific.
posts.caption: India hosted the Quad Foreign Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi on May 26. EAM @DrSJaishankar welcomed counterparts from Australia, Japan and the US for discussions on a Free and Open Indo-Pacific.

posts.text: Never let India's head bow. Saluted the brave BSF jawans and outlined our massive 'Smart Border' plan. We will use cutting-edge technology to make our borders impenetrable against infiltration.
posts.caption: Never let India's head bow. Saluted the brave BSF jawans and outlined our massive 'Smart Border' plan. We will use cutting-edge technology to make our borders impenetrable against infiltration.

posts.text: NEET. CBSE. SSC. And today CUET. Four exams. One crore children. Not a single one conducted with honesty. Claims of 'vishwa guru,' but can't conduct even one exam in the country — Modi ji has completely ruined the entire education system.
posts.caption: NEET. CBSE. SSC. And today CUET. Four exams. One crore children. Not a single one conducted with honesty. Claims of 'vishwa guru,' but can't conduct even one exam in the country — Modi ji has completely ruined the entire education system.

posts.text: The loss of lives in a tragic accident on the Betwa River in Hamirpur district is extremely heartbreaking and heart-rending. Have directed officials to intensify relief and rescue operations immediately.
posts.caption: The loss of lives in a tragic accident on the Betwa River in Hamirpur district is extremely heartbreaking and heart-rending. Have directed officials to intensify relief and rescue operations immediately.

posts.text: CUET exam disrupted again today. Technical glitches at centres across Delhi, Noida, Varanasi, Bangalore and more. This government can't conduct a single exam properly. The youth of this country deserve better.

posts.text: Interacted with FM Tsahkna of Estonia and European Commissioner for the Mediterranean Šuica at the Gymnich meeting in Cyprus. Productive discussions on strengthening India-EU ties.
posts.caption: Interacted with FM Tsahkna of Estonia and European Commissioner for the Mediterranean Šuica at the Gymnich meeting in Cyprus. Productive discussions on strengthening India-EU ties.

posts.text: The momentum on reforms has not come down at all. The 'reform express' PM Modi spoke of guided the drafting of the Finance Bill. Our goal: make India more economically vibrant while ensuring inclusivity for every section of society.
posts.caption: The momentum on reforms has not come down at all. The 'reform express' PM Modi spoke of guided the drafting of the Finance Bill. Our goal: make India more economically vibrant while ensuring inclusivity for every section of society.

posts.text: Focused on driving growth with local jobs, better lives and dignity. Adani Group continues to deliver — Ambuja achieved highest-ever annual volume of 73.7 MnT. Building India's future, one project at a time.
posts.caption: Focused on driving growth with local jobs, better lives and dignity. Adani Group continues to deliver — Ambuja achieved highest-ever annual volume of 73.7 MnT. Building India's future, one project at a time.

posts.text: AI will define the next era of entertainment. As India's largest media and entertainment platform, Reliance has the responsibility to lead this transformation — reimagining everything from script to screen.
posts.caption: AI will define the next era of entertainment. As India's largest media and entertainment platform, Reliance has the responsibility to lead this transformation — reimagining everything from script to screen.

posts.text: Being an ethical company is not about being perfect. It is about acknowledging imperfections and working to address them with integrity. That is what builds lasting trust.
posts.caption: Being an ethical company is not about being perfect. It is about acknowledging imperfections and working to address them with integrity. That is what builds lasting trust.

posts.text: Conferred the Khel Ratna awards on our outstanding athletes. India's youth are making us proud on the global stage — in chess, athletics, hockey and shooting. Their dedication inspires the nation.
posts.caption: Conferred the Khel Ratna awards on our outstanding athletes. India's youth are making us proud on the global stage — in chess, athletics, hockey and shooting. Their dedication inspires the nation.

posts.text: Iran must agree that they will never have a Nuclear Weapon or Bomb. The Hormuz Strait must be immediately open, no tolls, for unrestricted shipping traffic, in both directions. Ships caught in the Strait due to our amazing and unprecedented Naval Blockade may start the process of 'heading home!' Say HELLO to your wives, husbands, parents, and families from me, your favorite President!
posts.caption: Iran must agree that they will never have a Nuclear Weapon or Bomb. The Hormuz Strait must be immediately open, no tolls, for unrestricted shipping traffic, in both directions. posts.text: Labour has no coherent plan for Britain. Tony Blair's own words confirm what we've been saying. The country deserves better than a government that lurches from crisis to crisis without direction.
posts.caption: Labour has no coherent plan for Britain. Tony Blair's own words confirm what we've been saying. The country deserves better than a government that lurches from crisis to crisis without direction.

posts.text: Medicaid fraud is real. Over the last 10 years, $1.1 trillion in improper payments. In Ohio alone, expenses went from $27 billion to $47 billion in a decade. We prosecute the bad guys and put billions back in the pockets of people playing by the rules.
posts.caption: Medicaid fraud is real. Over the last 10 years, $1.1 trillion in improper payments. In Ohio alone, expenses went from $27 billion to $47 billion in a decade. We prosecute the bad guys and put billions back in the pockets of people playing by the rules.

posts.text: Proud to support initiatives that strengthen families and communities across America. The values we share as a nation — hard work, faith, and service — are what make us strong.
posts.caption: Proud to support initiatives that strengthen families and communities across America. The values we share as a nation — hard work, faith, and service — are what make us strong.

posts.text: Restoring accountability at the FBI. We are rooting out corruption and ensuring the Bureau serves the American people — not political agendas. Justice must be blind.
posts.caption: Restoring accountability at the FBI. We are rooting out corruption and ensuring the Bureau serves the American people — not political agendas. Justice must be blind.

posts.text: AI policy is about getting the balance right — enabling innovation while protecting American interests. Excited about the progress we're making on responsible AI development.
posts.caption: AI policy is about getting the balance right — enabling innovation while protecting American interests. Excited about the progress we're making on responsible AI development.

posts.text: The World Bank must evolve faster to address today's overlapping crises — climate, conflict, and inequality. We are reforming how we operate to deliver bigger impact where it matters most.
posts.caption: The World Bank must evolve faster to address today's overlapping crises — climate, conflict, and inequality. We are reforming how we operate to deliver bigger impact where it matters most.

posts.text: Ten years on from the Brexit referendum, we've got to look forward, not backwards. A stronger, closer relationship with Europe is in the UK's best interest, particularly in a world as volatile as it is.
posts.caption: Ten years on from the Brexit referendum, we've got to look forward, not backwards. A stronger, closer relationship with Europe is in the UK's best interest, particularly in a world as volatile as it is.

posts.text: Welcomed Microsoft's historic A$25 billion investment in Australia — their largest ever. This is about jobs, cybersecurity, and making sure Australians benefit from the AI era. A massive win for our national AI plan.
posts.caption: Welcomed Microsoft's historic A$25 billion investment in Australia — their largest ever. This is about jobs, cybersecurity, and making sure Australians benefit from the AI era. A massive win for our national AI plan.

posts.text: France and the UK will co-chair the next meeting of the 40-nation group exploring options for keeping the Strait of Hormuz open after the Iran conflict. Diplomacy and determination — that is how we protect global trade.
posts.caption: France and the UK will co-chair the next meeting of the 40-nation group exploring options for keeping the Strait of Hormuz open after the Iran conflict. Diplomacy and determination — that is how we protect global trade.

posts.text: The UAE continues to build bridges — between nations, between cultures, and between the present and the future. Our vision for the next 50 years is clear: lead through innovation, openness and excellence.
posts.caption: The UAE continues to build bridges — between nations, between cultures, and between the present and the future. Our vision for the next 50 years is clear: lead through innovation, openness and excellence.

posts.text: SpaceX has not committed to leasing Colossus for years, although it's possible that may be what happens. The short term was our request, not Anthropic's. We won't leave them hanging and will provide a reasonable off-ramp, but if compute gets super tight I said we might need it back at some point.
posts.caption: SpaceX has not committed to leasing Colossus for years, although it's possible that may be what happens. The short term was our request, not Anthropic's. We won't leave them hanging and will provide a reasonable off-ramp, but if compute gets super tight I said we might need it back at some point.

posts.text: Committed additional funding to the Oversight Board through 2028. Independent content oversight matters. Also — 2026 is going to be a big year for delivering personal superintelligence and building infrastructure for the future.
posts.caption: Committed additional funding to the Oversight Board through 2028. Independent content oversight matters. Also — 2026 is going to be a big year for delivering personal superintelligence and building infrastructure for the future.

posts.text: Companies are already blowing through their annual token budgets and it's only May. Unveiled Gemini 3.5 Flash at I/O — if companies shifted 80% of workloads to Flash, they'd save over $1 billion annually. That's real savings they can pour back into their company.
posts.caption: Companies are already blowing through their annual token budgets and it's only May. Unveiled Gemini 3.5 Flash at I/O — if companies shifted 80% of workloads to Flash, they'd save over $1 billion annually. That's real savings they can pour back into their company.

posts.text: Announced a historic A$25 billion investment in Australia — Microsoft's largest there. We're expanding Azure AI infrastructure, deepening cybersecurity partnerships, and helping the nation seize the benefits of the AI era. 2026 is the defining year for AI at scale.
posts.caption: Announced a historic A$25 billion investment in Australia — Microsoft's largest there. We're expanding Azure AI infrastructure, deepening cybersecurity partnerships, and helping the nation seize the benefits of the AI era. 2026 is the defining year for AI at scale.

posts.text: OpenAI is preparing to go public. We closed a $122 billion funding round earlier this year and launched Codex to compete head-to-head with Anthropic for business users. The AI race is just getting started.
posts.caption: OpenAI is preparing to go public. We closed a $122 billion funding round earlier this year and launched Codex to compete head-to-head with Anthropic for business users. The AI race is just getting started.

posts.text: I will transition to Executive Chairman on September 1. Incredibly proud of everything we've built at Apple. John Ternus will take the helm as CEO — he's the right leader for Apple's next chapter. I'll continue to support the company I love.
posts.caption: I will transition to Executive Chairman on September 1. Incredibly proud of everything we've built at Apple. John Ternus will take the helm as CEO — he's the right leader for Apple's next chapter. I'll continue to support the company I love.

posts.text: Taiwan is the epicentre of the AI revolution. Nvidia could spend as much as $150 billion a year here. Many years ago we had 10 partners. Five years ago, maybe 50 partners. Now we have 150 partners. Excited for Computex and GTC Taipei next week. A new era of PC.
posts.caption: Taiwan is the epicentre of the AI revolution. Nvidia could spend as much as $150 billion a year here. Many years ago we had 10 partners. Five years ago, maybe 50 partners. Now we have 150 partners. Excited for Computex and GTC Taipei next week. A new era of PC.

posts.text: India's digital public infrastructure is a model for the world. From UPI to Aadhaar, we've shown that technology can drive financial inclusion at population scale. The next frontier is AI-powered governance.
posts.caption: India's digital public infrastructure is a model for the world. From UPI to Aadhaar, we've shown that technology can drive financial inclusion at population scale. The next frontier is AI-powered governance.

posts.text: AI is going to be the most transformative technology of our lifetime. But we need to make sure it benefits everyone, not just the wealthy. I'm particularly excited about AI's potential in healthcare and education in low-income countries.
posts.caption: AI is going to be the most transformative technology of our lifetime. But we need to make sure it benefits everyone, not just the wealthy. I'm particularly excited about AI's potential in healthcare and education in low-income countries.

posts.text: IBM is embedding AI into every layer of enterprise operations. The companies that move fastest to adopt AI-driven automation will define the next decade of business. Hybrid cloud and AI — that's the future.
posts.caption: IBM is embedding AI into every layer of enterprise operations. The companies that move fastest to adopt AI-driven automation will define the next decade of business. Hybrid cloud and AI — that's the future.

posts.text: Creativity and AI are not at odds — they amplify each other. At Adobe, we're building AI tools that empower creators to do their best work faster than ever. The creative economy is just getting started.
posts.caption: Creativity and AI are not at odds — they amplify each other. At Adobe, we're building AI tools that empower creators to do their best work faster than ever. The creative economy is just getting started.

posts.text: Building technology that serves the public good requires patience, conviction, and a willingness to think long-term. Excited about the next chapter in AI and what it means for how we communicate.
posts.caption: Building technology that serves the public good requires patience, conviction, and a willingness to think long-term. Excited about the next chapter in AI and what it means for how we communicate.

posts.text: Leading Chanel means honoring 113 years of heritage while fearlessly innovating for the future. Diversity of thought is our greatest competitive advantage. Human creativity will always be at the heart of luxury.
posts.caption: Leading Chanel means honoring 113 years of heritage while fearlessly innovating for the future. Diversity of thought is our greatest competitive advantage. Human creativity will always be at the heart of luxury.

posts.text: At FedEx, we're using AI and data to transform global logistics. Our intelligent supply chain platform is making deliveries faster, more sustainable, and more reliable. The future of commerce is data-driven.
